{{Top|canon=Paralyzing dart}}
A '''paralysis dart''' was a small projectile designed to be launched from a wrist-mounted personal weapon system. This dart was a favorite among [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who wanted to capture rather than kill their targets. The toxin found on this dart affected the [[nervous system]], causing grogginess or paralysis. The bounty hunter [[Mira]] was known to use this type of weapon towards the end of the [[Dark Wars]].
